message.content:
Each day, the probability that Team A is selected is \(\frac{2}{3}\), since Team A is in 2 of the 3 possible pairs of teams.

Let \(X\) be the number of days out of 3 that Team A is selected. Then

\[
P(X \ge 2)=P(X=2)+P(X=3)
\]

Using the binomial probability formula with \(p=\frac{2}{3}\):

\[
P(X=2)=\binom{3}{2}\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^2\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)
=3\cdot \frac{4}{9}\cdot \frac{1}{3}
=\frac{12}{27}
\]

\[
P(X=3)=\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)^3=\frac{8}{27}
\]

So,

\[
P(X\ge 2)=\frac{12}{27}+\frac{8}{27}=\frac{20}{27}
\]

The answer is \(\frac{20}{27}\).
